title: Component manifest (components/<id>/component.json)
description: A component defined by the course: a block type (level block) or a screen layout (level screen). template.html renders its props (bindings, lists, conditions, slots, behaviour hooks: docs/components.md); component.css styles it (cascade layer elabora.components). No JavaScript: interactions come from the player's behaviours and primitives. Words live in props, never in the template. A fork extends another component (built-in or not) and remembers it. Authors edit instances through the props form; agents and developers edit the definition.

id.description: Equal to the folder name. Must not be a built-in type.

title.description: Name shown to authors in the block picker.

description.description: What it is for, when to use it.

instructions.description: Authoring instructions for agents (like x-ai-instructions of built-in blocks).

version.description: Version of the definition. Increase it when the definition changes; a change of the props shape needs a migration (migrations.mjs) for the instances.

level.description: block: a block type placed on screens and in slots. screen: a screen layout (screen layout: "<id>"); its template may hold one data-title element for the screen title.

extends.description: Fork: the component this one was derived from. Without props, template, slots or fallback, the parent's are used; propsExtend adds props to the parent's. A fork of quiz, numeric, fill-in, sort, reflection, decision or results keeps that behaviour (scoring, saved state, SCORM records), so its template must provide the behaviour hooks.

version.description: Version of the parent when the fork was made (to see later changes of the parent).

origin.description: Written by elabora component add/upgrade: the library the component was copied from. The course keeps its own copy (pinned); upgrades are explicit.

props.description: JSON Schema of the props (type object, properties, required). Strings take x-kind: text (default), markdown (Elabora Markdown, maths included), tex (LaTeX equation), asset (file in assets/), token (name of a theme token, rendered as var(--t-…)). Mark text x-translatable. x-group "design" marks settings authors may change (tokens, enums). Text and Markdown props accept { "textRef": "TXT-n" } in instances (locked plan texts).

propsExtend.description: Forks only: schema merged into the parent's props schema (add a property, a field to list items…).

slots.description: Named places where authors put blocks (native blocks or other components). Each slot is an empty element marked data-slot="<id>" in the template.

default.description: Receives blocks without slot. At most one slot; the first slot otherwise.

accepts.description: Block types allowed in this slot (all if absent). A fork is accepted where its parent is.

fallback.description: The component expressed with native blocks, for exports, text views, translation and detach. Items: { type, props } templates where strings take {{prop}}, {{#list}}…{{/list}}, {{^prop}}…{{/prop}}; { "$if": "expr", … }; { "$each": "list", … }; { "$slot": "<slot id>" }. Without it, Elabora generates one from the props. Forks of a built-in fall back to the built-in.

styles.description: Named styles of this component, with a description for editors (forks inherit them). The course theme can add more in theme.styles.<id>.

examples.description: Sample instances: checked like real instances, shown by elabora component preview and by editors.

fullBleed.description: Screen level: the screen spans the whole window, edge to edge (no page padding, no maximum width): the layout owns its spacing.
